new_split = '''def split_blocks(g):
    """Split a grid into two blocks around a separator line (uniform column or row whose color appears nowhere else); returns (A, B)."""
    W, H = len(g[0]), len(g)
    colors = [x for r in g for x in r]
    for j in range(W):
        col = [r[j] for r in g]
        if len(set(col)) == 1 and colors.count(col[0]) == H:
            return [r[:j] for r in g], [r[j + 1:] for r in g]
    for i in range(H):
        row = g[i]
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and colors.count(row[0]) == W:
            return g[:i], g[i + 1:]
    raise ValueError("no separator found")'''
